headline: TotalEnergies Posts Record Profit on High Oil Prices, Lifts Dividend
summary: TotalEnergies announced record quarterly profits driven by elevated global crude oil prices, noting that the profit surge will be passed on to shareholders through increased dividends.
why: TotalEnergies is one of the world's primary integrated oil majors; its cash returns set expectations across the European energy sector.

impacts.name: TotalEnergies SE
impacts.why: Record net earnings support increased dividend payouts to equity investors.
